gaps.sentence: She was the first woman ___ the peak in winter.
gaps.explanation: the first/second/last + to-infinitive: the first woman to climb.

gaps.sentence: My boss won't ___ me take Friday off.
gaps.explanation: let + object + bare infinitive: won't let me take. (allow/permit take to: allow me to take.)

gaps.sentence: The hotel offered ___ our room free of charge.
gaps.explanation: offer takes the to-infinitive: offered to upgrade.

gaps.sentence: I can't imagine ___ in a tiny village again.

gaps.explanation: pretend + to-infinitive; negative: not to hear.

gaps.sentence: They're planning ___ the flat before selling it.
gaps.explanation: plan + to-infinitive (plan on + -ing also occurs informally): planning to redecorate.

gaps.sentence: They managed ___ the fire before it spread.
gaps.explanation: manage takes the to-infinitive: managed to put out.

gaps.sentence: We expect ___ the results by Friday.
gaps.explanation: expect takes the to-infinitive: expect to receive.
